question: Is cereal a soup?
scope: A bowl of breakfast cereal with milk. Compare food forms and conventions; a counterexample weakens one criterion without deciding every soup definition.

turns.text: Cereal is soup. It has bits in liquid, and you eat it with a spoon.

claims.hint: Name a food or drink with bits in liquid that is not soup.
Name something you eat with a spoon that is not soup.

rejected.reason: That is already a soup. Name a different spoon food.

turns.text: Soup must be hot and not sweet. Cereal is cold and sweet.

rejected.reason: That is served hot. Name a cold soup.

turns.text: Soup is cooked together. Cereal and milk are made separately.

turns.text: Cereal becomes soup when the flakes soak and soften, and the milk takes on their flavor.

turns.text: Soup is a main meal, not dessert. Sweet milk with soft bits is a dessert or drink.
